mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 71 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Area High School. We also have a Waning Gibbous moon visible tonight, and for space enthusiasts, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:17 AM as it travels from the northwest toward the east northeast.
The Verona Senior Center is updating their flooring starting September 1, which will limit services to wellness appointments and outdoor programming until regular operations resume on September 10.

There is plenty happening in Verona, starting with Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow is packed with activities including Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
On August 25, Verona police officers performed life-saving measures on a 68-year-old man experiencing a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive by using an AED to successfully restore his pulse.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently closed, but it will open today at 10:00 AM.
